desc:
Yes. That’s flavour. Our mix of fruity flavours isn’t like ordinary sweets – they’re gourmet. All our gourmet jelly beans are made with natural flavours, plant‑based colours, and are gelatine‑free, gluten‑free, and free from palm oil.

The Jelly Bean Factory · Tube · Fruity
ingredients:
ASSORTED FLAVOUR JELLY CANDY. Gluten free.

Ingredients: sugar, glucose syrup, maize starch, fruit juice concentrate (pineapple, orange, apple), flavourings, acids (citric acid, fumaric acid), concentrates from (carrot, apple, pumpkin, radish, spirulina, blackcurrant), glazing agents (E901, E903, E904), acidity regulator (trisodium citrate), colour (plain caramel), coconut oil.

All flavours are not guaranteed.
